_: It.32+It.33: a PAID follower that plugs straight into the VANILLA follower system (recommended over the self-managed follower_paid_spec.json — the user prefers this). Only the recruit trigger + gold are custom; the recruit fragment calls DialogueFollowerScript.SetFollower(akSpeaker), after which vanilla's own trade/wait/follow/dismiss dialogue manages her and follower-manager mods (AFT/EFF/NFF) pick her up automatically. Custom records survive vanilla follower status: custom CombatStyle (combat AI not overridden) + a Sandbox downtime package (runs when not actively following). It.33 DEEPENS her: follower-only backstory topics + SITUATIONAL lines gated on runtime state (low-health via GetActorValuePercent, night via GetCurrentTime). `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn` — she sandboxes the inn; talk to her, pay 500; then backstory/situational topics appear by context, and vanilla wait/trade/dismiss all work.

combatStyles._: A melee-favouring sellsword style — proof that a custom CSTY is preserved through vanilla follower status (the vanilla follow/combat-override packages set no CombatStyle, so the actor's base CSTY drives combat).

packages._: DAILY ROUTINE, tier 1 (night). A Sleep package (template 0x019717) — a specialized Sandbox that actively SEEKS A BED and beds down. Gated by `schedule` to 22:00–07:00 (hour=22, duration=540min). It sits ABOVE MF_VanillaSandbox in her package list, so the engine runs it during its window and falls through to the sandbox the rest of the day. lockDoors=false because she sleeps in the SHARED Sleeping Giant Inn — a follower locking the inn would be wrong (vanilla defaults lockDoors=true for an NPC's own house). radius bumped to 1024 to widen the bed search across the common room. Like the sandbox, this whole routine only runs when she's NOT actively following — the vanilla follower-alias package overrides it while she trails the player.

DAILY ROUTINE, tier 2 (waking-hours default). An unconditioned Sandbox — her lowest-priority fallback, active whenever the Sleep window above isn't (i.e. ~07:00–22:00) AND she's not following. She eats/sits/wanders the inn and chats with patrons instead of standing frozen. While she's actively following, the alias package overrides this; combat preempts it and she resumes after. No `location` ⇒ she sandboxes around her editor location (the inn). To add more tiers (a midday meal spot, a work bench), add more scheduled packages ABOVE this one in her `packages` list — list order = priority, first matching schedule+conditions wins.

npcs.name: Sigrid the Sword
npcs._greeting: Makes her conversable (host quest + Hello). The recruit topic surfaces on top.
npcs.greeting: You look like you could use a blade.
npcs._voiceType: FemaleEvenToned (0x013ADD) — a VoicesFollowerNeutral voice, REQUIRED so vanilla's follow/wait/trade/dismiss dialogue (all GetIsVoiceType-gated) surfaces once SetFollower puts her in CurrentFollowerFaction.
npcs._factions: Only Whiterun crime/citizen (door/gate traversal). NOT in any follower faction at start — SetFollower's alias adds CurrentFollowerFaction at recruit.
npcs._combatStyle: Custom CSTY — preserved while she's a follower (the vanilla follow/combat-override packages set no CombatStyle, so the actor's base CSTY drives combat).
npcs._packages: Daily downtime routine, in PRIORITY ORDER (list order = priority; engine runs the first whose schedule+conditions match). Tier 1 MF_NightSleep (22:00–07:00, seeks a bed). Tier 2 MF_VanillaSandbox (unconditioned waking-hours fallback). All of this only runs when she's NOT actively following — the vanilla follower alias package overrides it while she trails the player.

quests._: Hosts the recruit + self-intro topics. StartGameEnabled so they're served when you talk to her.
quests.name: ModForge Vanilla Hire

dialogue._: Recruit line. Shown only when the player can afford it AND has no current follower (GetGlobalValue PlayerFollowerCount==0 — the same global vanilla uses; avoids stomping the single follower slot). Fragment takes gold + DialogueFollowerScript.SetFollower(akSpeaker). After that the line hides (count==1) and vanilla follow/wait/trade/dismiss take over.
dialogue.prompt: Here's 500 gold. Fight at my side.

dialogue._: FOLLOWER-ONLY self-introduction. Gated on GetInFaction CurrentFollowerFaction==1, so it ONLY appears after she's recruited (SetFollower's alias adds that faction) and disappears when dismissed. No fragment — just spoken lines. This is the pattern for any 'unlocked once she travels with you' dialogue (backstory, banter, personal quest hooks).
responses: Sigrid, they call me. Grew up in Markarth's smoke and steel — learned the sword before I could read.
I've sold this blade from Solitude to Riften. You're just the latest to be glad of it.

dialogue._: Backstory, follower-only. Same CurrentFollowerFaction gate — a second 'travels-with-you' topic. Shows the pattern scales: every extra topic is just another entry with the same gate.
dialogue.prompt: Where did you learn to fight?
responses: Markarth's fighting pits, when I was too young to know better. You learn fast when losing means bleeding in the dirt.
A retired legionnaire took pity on me — taught me the shield before the blade. Kept me alive long enough to get good.

dialogue._: SITUATIONAL — only when she's badly hurt. GetActorValuePercent Health < 0.5 on Subject (herself), AND follower-only. Demonstrates a player-initiated line that surfaces only in a runtime state. (Percent is a 0..1 fraction; 0.5 = below half health.)
dialogue.prompt: You're hurt. Can you keep going?
responses: I've fought through worse with less. But I'll not say no if you've a potion to spare.
Flesh wound. Mostly. Give me a moment and I'm at your back again.

dialogue._: SITUATIONAL — only at night. GetCurrentTime >= 19 (after 7pm), AND follower-only. GetCurrentTime is a no-arg function returning the game hour 0..24; no param/ref needed.
dialogue.prompt: It's getting late. Should we make camp?
responses: Aye. Even a sellsword sleeps. Find us somewhere with four walls and I'll take first watch.
The roads are worse after dark — bandits, and worse than bandits. Best we hole up till light.

_banter: PROACTIVE banter (It.34) — lines she says UNPROMPTED. All four collapse into one ambient topic (Misc/SNAM='IDLE', no branch) with Random-flagged INFOs; the engine plays a matching one on its own while she has idle chatter (her Sandbox package + the vanilla follow package both allow it). Each is follower-only (CurrentFollowerFaction==1) plus a situational gate, so she only comments while travelling with you and only in the right context. This is the unprompted counterpart to the player-asked situational topics above.

responses: I'm bleeding... give me a breath before the next one.
Quiet, this hour. I almost miss the din of a good fight.
Stone walls and smoke. Feels like Markarth in here.
Lead on. This blade gets restless.

placements._: Sigrid in the Sleeping Giant Inn common room (any in-room coord; actors snap to navmesh).
